result.brief: 提出 CARE-WM 训练方法，用自预测自条件化与自适应潜空间正则，使潜世界模型的预测误差更低、潜距离与任务代价更一致，无需额外监督或代价模型。
result.reason: Trains latent world-model predictors with self-conditioning and latent regularization for planning; contributes to latent world model training and latent geometry alignment, though framed around control tasks.
